'''''Bastion''''' was an ancient refueling tanker [[Wraith Squadron]] captured on [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]] during a [[Halmad campaign|mission]] disguised as the [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force]]. Wraith [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Kell Tainer]] rigged the tanker to blow upon a signal from him, which the Wraiths planned to use in demolishing a newly constructed starfighter base near the city of [[Hullis]] on Halmad.

Their plan failed however, when [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s flagship [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']] used its [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] on the ''Bastion''. Improvising, Tainer and his group escaped by flying the [[Narra (shuttle)|''Narra'']] out of ''Bastion''{{'s}} hold, and then detonating the tanker as it approached ''Iron Fist''{{'s}} hangar bay.
